<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="a04-lock-queue" name="lock-queue"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" background="#fbfaf7" math="0" shadow="0" adaptiveColors="none"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="hdr" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#5d665d;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="three sessions, one table" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="22" width="300" x="40" y="18" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="axis" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#5d665d;fontSize=10;" value="time →" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="22" width="80" x="210" y="18" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#172018;fontSize=11;" value="session 1
a long report" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="160" x="40" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l2" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#172018;fontSize=11;" value="session 2
the migration" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="160" x="40" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l3" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#172018;fontSize=11;" value="session 3
an ordinary SELECT" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="160" x="40" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d9f4e8;strokeColor=#0f766e;fontColor=#172018;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" value="holds ACCESS SHARE — granted, for the whole transaction" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="650" x="210" y="64" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fdf3e7;strokeColor=#b45309;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;fontColor=#172018;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" value="waiting for ACCESS EXCLUSIVE — 18.1 s" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="581" x="279" y="124" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2run" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d9f4e8;strokeColor=#0f766e;fontColor=#172018;fontSize=9;align=center;" value="runs
commits" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="46" x="860" y="124" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#5d665d;dashed=1;fontColor=#172018;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" value="waiting — 16.0 s" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="558" x="348" y="184" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a21" edge="1" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#5d665d;endArrow=classic;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="330" y="124" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="330" y="104" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a21l" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#5d665d;fontSize=10;" value="blocked by" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="90" x="338" y="104" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a32" edge="1" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#b45309;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="430" y="184" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="430" y="164" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a32l" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#b45309;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;" value="blocked by the ALTER — not by session 1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="300" x="438" y="164" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rel" edge="1" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#5d665d;dashed=1;endArrow=none;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="860" y="52" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="860" y="236" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rell" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#5d665d;fontSize=10;" value="session 1 commits — the queue
drains in order, not all at once" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="270" x="640" y="240" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tm1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#5d665d;fontSize=10;" value="t = 0" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="60" x="210" y="104" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tm2" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#5d665d;fontSize=10;" value="t = 2 s" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="60" x="279" y="164" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tm3" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#5d665d;fontSize=10;" value="t = 4 s" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="60" x="348" y="224" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="caption" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#5d665d;fontSize=11;" value="ACCESS SHARE never conflicts with ACCESS SHARE, so session 3 could have run immediately. It queues behind a lock request that is itself still waiting — and then behind the ALTER's own transaction." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="880" x="40" y="286" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
